svg.title: Paired Gaussian and structured bank recovery of the complete two-mode minimum set.
svg.desc: English: Paired Gaussian and structured bank recovery of the complete two-mode minimum set. 繁體中文：純 Gaussian 與 structured 配對 banks 對完整兩模態極小值集合的覆蓋。

cc:Work.dc:description: Pointwise-minimization initialization diagnostics for the ZIP M=2 zero-phase control, chosen for its independent complete census, not for a preferred seed outcome. Nested 32/64/128 prefixes compare ten independent paired banks: pure Gaussian draws versus those same draws with five origin and signed-coordinate slots replaced by structured controls at every budget. Panel (a) first averages each bank's stable coverage across all nine declared loads, then displays the bank mean plus/minus one sample standard deviation across ten banks—not a confidence interval and not load points as independent repeats. Panel (b) counts how many banks recover every one of the 4 certified signed strict minima at the predeclared diagnostic load 76, the first budget load above the zero-phase secondary branch birth. At 128 starts the observed recovery markers coincide, but the two initialization banks still differ in their five structured slots; overlapping markers do not mean missing data or identical designs. Joining lines guide the eye: no intermediate budget is measured. This is not a ten-bank continuation study or a physical attraction-basin probability. Ordinary/deflated pointwise root diagnostics, other cases, all failures, and the original 512 diagnostic are retained separately.
